name: sehosun
description: Claude Code plugins by Seho Sun (CAMP Lab, Yeungnam University) - academic paper automation, computational chemistry, and remote-machine setup. Add with `/plugin marketplace add SHSUN76/sehosun` (a git source); do not add by raw URL to this file. Entries marked PRIVATE REPO resolve only for GitHub accounts with read access.

plugins.name: compchem
plugins.description: PRIVATE REPO (CAMP Lab members only). DFT / MD / MLIP workflow router for Quantum ESPRESSO, LAMMPS, OpenMM, MACE and CHGNet. Socratic calculation planner, SSSP-backed input validator, 7-MUST safe restart protocol, relaxation-optimizer advisor, project tracker, POV-Ray multiview vision check, and 5-pass SOP verification.

plugins.name: paper-autopilot
plugins.description: PRIVATE REPO (CAMP Lab members only). MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with paper-autopilot-open - the two editions share 9 skill names, ~32 agent names and the /paper-autopilot command tree, so install only one. Multi-corpus (MoE) edition of the academic paper pipeline: folder scaffold, G1/G2 forcing-question gates, experimental SOP design, figure mockup evolution, corpus-routed drafting, and an adversarial spec-review loop.

plugins.name: paper-autopilot-open
plugins.description: MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with paper-autopilot (MoE edition) - installs disabled by default for that reason; enable it only if the MoE edition is not installed. Public standalone edition of the academic paper pipeline: folder scaffold, forcing-question gates, experimental SOP design, figure mockup evolution, corpus-grounded drafting, six-axis referee review, and docx export. Ships a guided onboarding skill plus dual local/Supabase RAG.

plugins.name: tailscale-ssh
plugins.description: Establish SSH between two machines with no VPN, no port forwarding and no inbound firewall rule, by building a WireGuard tunnel over Tailscale and writing the ssh config block. Covers both roles (client and target), Windows OpenSSH Server setup, tag-based ACL isolation, and a troubleshooting catalogue.

plugins.name: vesta
plugins.description: Crystal-structure figure automation built on VESTA and POV-Ray. Infers the three style axes (representation model, colour palette, render path) from the request and asks only what it cannot infer, then runs the pipeline: ASE structure validation -> VESTA CLI scene generation with field-verified .vesta format knowledge -> pastel restyling -> optional POV-Ray raytraced PNG. Includes a one-click dependency setup skill that downloads portable VESTA and checks POV-Ray and Python packages.

plugins.name: llmwiki
plugins.description: 제텔카스텐 규칙으로 임시노트·문헌노트를 영구노트로 승격하는 개인 위키 플러그인. 승격 게이트(자기 말로 재작성·태그·링크 2개)와 루만 번호는 스크립트가 판정하고, 승격 로그가 채점 아티팩트가 된다. 「화학공학을 위한 AI」 수업용(한국어).

plugins.name: camp-talk
plugins.description: Turns a manuscript or research folder into a conference talk deck through a three-stage pipeline: an asset ledger that measures every figure first, a deterministic fixed-grid pptxgenjs builder, and an automated QA pass. The model never places coordinates, so title, band and takeaway line sit in the same place on every slide and figures keep their native aspect ratio.

plugins.name: origin
plugins.description: Builds publication-grade OriginLab graphs from tidy csv/xlsx data and embeds them into PowerPoint as editable OLE objects. Style is inherited from ten donor .opj archetypes recovered from published decks, with a house style (32 pt axis titles, 24 pt bold tick labels, axis thickness 4) enforced on top. Requires a local Origin 2021 installation and originpro.

plugins.name: ppt-image
plugins.description: Generates 4K slide images, diagrams and dense infographics from a markdown slide draft using Gemini (Nano Banana) or OpenAI image models. Includes document-context prompt enrichment, per-slide aspect-ratio batching, Tavily reference-image search and exponential-backoff retries.
